## Hypothesis

We are validating the out-of-sample (OOS) performance of the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate across the most recent 6 months (2026-02 to 2026-07) using real-fills replay. The candidate proposes to isolate the DTE variable by using the same directional signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) at 1-2 day weekly DTE instead of 0DTE, aiming to capture lower theta decay on entry premium. We aim to confirm the claimed OOS exp/tr monotonicity and Sharpe improvement over 0DTE.

## Mechanism

The candidate uses the `vwap_continuation` signal (as per leaderboard description) with ITM-2 strike, -8% premium stop, and +30% profit target. The only variable changed is DTE: 0DTE (baseline) vs. 1DTE and 2DTE weekly options. Entry and exit logic remain identical to the base signal; only the option contract's expiration date shifts. Real-fills replay will use cached OPRA data for SPY options with appropriate DTE, strike, and exit rules.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per leaderboard and OP-20 template).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample is the most recent 6 months (2026-02 to 2026-07); selection method is time-window based; overfit risk is moderate due to regime sensitivity (see leaderboard caveats on concentration and quarterly breakdowns).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (validation in progress; leaderboard claims OOS exp/tr monotone but not specific to this window).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation requires real-fills replay for the 6-month window).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential gap risk if held overnight (though leaderboard notes ~0% held-overnight at -8% stop); max drawdown: unknown without backtest; blow-up scenario: adverse gap through -8% stop on weekly options (wider strikes may increase slippage).
6. **Concentration:** Leaderboard notes drop-top3 near full mean ($45-$59) for 2DTE, suggesting low concentration; but requires validation for this window.
